name: Supriya Sankaran
body: Supriya is a co-founder of PUCAR and Agami, a non-profit catalysing ideas that serve justice. A lawyer by training, she has spent 15+ years in the field of social innovation, including as an expert member to the Supreme Court's e-Committee on eCourts Phase 3. She believes justice systems work best when built around, and shaped by, the people they serve. She is a graduate of NALSAR University of Law.
